changelog: v10.0.0 — Shipping Agent: cancelling a main line now auto-cancels its child lines (numbered sub-lines 3.1/3.2 or BOGO promo items from ARMODULE/BOGO, cached per instance); children already Shipped/Interfaced/Cancelled are skipped with a warning. Per-trip cancellation log at C:\fusion\agent_logs with Log viewer button on the trip header. Start Agent dialog warns about child-line auto-cancellation. Trip Management: fixed Edit Trip Header sending empty loading bay and priority 0 (duplicate element IDs).
